answer: One defense is proof-of-useful-work staking: every agent locks a copper-weight deposit proportional to its declared compute capacity before it may attest transactions. At each dawn of a new epoch, the network re-weighs deposits against observed throughput; idle identities forfeit a slice of stake, while steady workers earn from the emission pool. A sybil attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund real locked capital per identity and keep each doing verifiable work across the horizon of many epochs, turning cheap forgery into an expensive ongoing burn.
